Her discography includes Songs from the Sofa (2023), the collaborative EP Kindred Spirits (2024), and her full-length album Shadows of a Ghost Town (2025), an evocative exploration of death, nature, and the soul of the West. Off-stage, she volunteers with Musicians on Call, bringing live music to patients at Children’s Hospital and the VA in Denver. With every song and show, she builds community, lifts up fellow artists, and reminds audiences why music matters. Off-stage, she volunteers with Musicians on Call, bringing live music to patients at Children’s Hospital and the VA in Denver. With every song and show, she builds community, lifts up fellow artists, and reminds audiences why music matters.
